varNotes.VAR_DISTRIBUTE_EON_TICKET: This var is read and written, but is always zero. The only way to obtain the Eon Ticket in Emerald is via Record Mixing
varNotes.VAR_CURRENT_SECRET_BASE: was probably allocated for VAR_FALLARBOR_TOWN_STATE at one point
varNotes.VAR_EVENT_RESET_STATE: Used for fixing save files from earlier versions
varNotes.VAR_PARTY_MENU_TUTOR_STATE: Used to distinguis between the normal move relearner and egg move tutor(More could be added in the future).
varNotes.VAR_STARTER_GEN: Used to track which set of starters the player chose from
varNotes.VAR_PETALBURG_GYM_STATE: 0-1: Wally tutorial, 2-6: 0-4 badges, 7: Defeated Norman, 8: Rematch Norman
varNotes.VAR_POKE_VIAL_CHARGES: Number of uses left in the Poke Vial before it needs to be refilled
varNotes.VAR_POKE_VIAL_MAX_CHARGES: Max number of uses for the Poke Vial after each charge
varNotes.VAR_LEAF_STATE: Used for the post game Leaf Battle
varNotes.VAR_SAFARI_ZONE_STATE: 0: In or out of SZ, 1: Player exiting SZ, 2: Player entering SZ
varNotes.VAR_HAS_ENTERED_BATTLE_FRONTIER: Var is used like a flag.
varNotes.VAR_BATTLE_FIELD_EFFECT_TYPE: Type of weather, terrain or room at the start of the battle
varNotes.VAR_TRACKCOUNT_WINS_HIGH: variable separated in two, high part
varNotes.VAR_TRACKCOUNT_WINS_LOW: variable separated in two, low part
varNotes.VAR_NEVER_READ_0x40E4: var is written to, but never read
varNotes.VAR_SECRET_BASE_STEP_COUNTER: Used by Secret Base TV programs
varNotes.VAR_SECRET_BASE_LAST_ITEM_USED: Used by Secret Base TV programs
varNotes.VAR_SECRET_BASE_LOW_TV_FLAGS: Used by Secret Base TV programs
varNotes.VAR_SECRET_BASE_HIGH_TV_FLAGS: Used by Secret Base TV programs
varNotes.VAR_SECRET_BASE_IS_NOT_LOCAL: Set to TRUE while in another player's secret base.
